title: Grand Vestibule
wikitext:
[[Image:Grand Vestibule.jpg|thumb|Grand Vestibule]]
The '''Grand Vestibule''' is the outermost chamber of the [[Scarlet Monastery]]. It holds the entrances to all of the dungeon's wings, and leads via short passages to the [[Chamber of Atonement]] in the graveyard wing, the [[Huntsman's Cloister]] in the library wing, the [[Training Grounds]] in the armory wing, and the [[Chapel Gardens]] in the cathedral wing. The latter two wings are barred by locked doors, and require [[the Scarlet Key]] to open. 

The vestibule itself is decorated with pillars and statues of scarlet warriors. It is often a contested place, as [[Horde]] and [[Alliance]]-affiliated adventurers mindle in the hall with sometimes brutal results.
